description: Thirty-second 16:9 homepage trailer for Kleo: one URL, plain words, a 4K video with narration, captions and music, five looks, rendered on a GPU while you wait in the chat.

scenes.title: One URL. Plain words.
scenes.voice: One URL. Plain words. That is all it takes.

shots.image_prompt: A dark studio desk at dusk, one laptop glowing cool cyan in the gloom, dust motes drifting slowly through the beam of a warm desk lamp.
The creator's eyes filling the frame, the laptop's cool glow flickering across them, her lashes blinking slowly.
The whole studio opening up around the creator, small at her desk by the tall window, rain streaking down the glass over city lights at dusk.

scenes.title: Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Grok and Cursor
scenes.voice: Plug Kleo into Claude, ChatGPT, Grok or Cursor. Ask for a Short, or a full video.

shots.image_prompt: A lone glowing cable running across the dark desk and into the side of the laptop, a pulse of cool light travelling along it toward the port.
A phone propped upright beside the laptop, a bright vertical clip of ocean waves playing on its screen, its colour spilling across the dark desk.
A wide monitor above the desk lighting the whole dark room with a widescreen shot of a canyon at golden hour, the glow washing over an empty chair.
shots.caption: SHORT OR FULL VIDEO

scenes.title: Written. Drawn. Narrated. Cut on the voice.
scenes.voice: It writes, draws, narrates, and cuts every shot on the voice.

shots.image_prompt: A grid of paper storyboard frames pinned across a dark studio wall, each sheet catching a different colour of warm light, the edges fluttering in a draft.
The wide monitor in the dark room, a photograph of a lighthouse on a cliff blooming across it from the centre, warm colour flooding the desk below.
A studio microphone in a dark booth, a warm ring of amber light on its mesh, the pop filter trembling as the air moves.

scenes.title: Rendered on a GPU while you wait
scenes.voice: Rendered on a GPU while you wait in the chat. Then the links arrive.

shots.image_prompt: A data hall at night, long rows of server racks blinking amber, cold air shimmering above the floor, thick cables sweeping overhead into the dark.
The creator leaning back in her chair in the warm lamp light, steam rising from a coffee cup beside the laptop, the room quiet around her.
shots.caption: WAIT IN THE CHAT

shots.image_prompt: The laptop screen blooming to life on the dark desk, warm light spreading across the wood and the coffee cup, steam curling up into the glow.

scenes.title: 4K. Captions. Music. Five looks.
scenes.voice: A 4K video with narration, captions and music. Five looks, cartoon to photoreal.

shots.image_prompt: A huge cinema screen in an empty dark hall filling with a crisp shot of a green mountain valley at dawn, its light washing over rows of empty seats.
A pair of studio headphones resting on the dark desk, a soft green level light pulsing beside them, the cable trailing off into the shadow.
Five tall screens in a row in a dark gallery, each glowing with a different picture of the same lighthouse, their reflections shimmering on the wet black floor.
shots.caption: FIVE LOOKS

scenes.title: Two free Shorts. No sign-up.
scenes.voice: Two free Shorts. No sign-up. One click at kleooai dot com.
